title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Joshua 3: the ark goes before the people and Israel crosses the Jordan on dry ground.

questions.text: From where did Israel move before they came to the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says Joshua got up early, and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan.

questions.text: What were the people to follow when they saw it?
questions.explanation: The officers said that when the people saw the ark of Yahweh's covenant and the Levitical priests bearing it, they were to follow it.

answers.text: A pillar of fire by night

questions.text: About how much space was to be kept between the people and the ark?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says there was to be a space of about two thousand cubits between them and the ark.

questions.text: What did Joshua tell the people to do, because Yahweh would do wonders tomorrow?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: "Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders among you."

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he would begin to do for Joshua that day?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel."

answers.text: Give him a crown before all the people
Show him the whole land from a mountain
Teach him a new song for the people
Magnify him in the sight of all Israel

questions.text: How many men were to be taken out of the tribes of Israel?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says: "Take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man."

answers.text: Twelve, a man for every tribe

questions.text: What does the text say the Jordan does all the time of harvest?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest.

answers.text: It becomes shallow enough to wade

questions.text: At which city did the waters from above rise up in one heap?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says the waters stood and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city beside Zarethan.

questions.text: Near which city did the people pass over?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 ends: "Then the people passed over near Jericho."

questions.text: Where did the priests stand while all Israel crossed over?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says the priests stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan until all the nation had passed over.

answers.text: On the far bank of the river
At the edge of the Salt Sea
On dry ground in the middle of the Jordan
